headline: Canadiens’ Chris Kreider out 6-8 weeks with lower-body injury
take:
Daily Faceoff reports Chris Kreider will miss six to eight weeks with a lower-body injury, which points to a return around the turn of the year.

Kreider's first season in Montreal has been quieter than the 50 points he put up last year in Anaheim: three goals and nine points in 19 games, on 13 minutes a night. The finishing is close to fair (3.62 expected goals for his three). The worry was elsewhere. At 5v5 the Canadiens get only 42% of the expected goals with him on the ice, nearly 12 points worse than without him, and they've scored 5.7 more goals with him out there than those chances deserved.

So the hole is smaller than his name suggests. The bigger question for a 12-3-4 team is how long it can keep outrunning an even split of the chances (49% of the expected goals) with goaltending that has saved almost nine goals more than expected.
